Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
May a vampire play bribes during a referendum that is automatically passing?

May a vampire play delaying tactics in a vote that is automatically passing?

I would say no in either case but can't find rulings supporting this.

Be careful when you fight the monsters, lest you become one.

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
From  general rulings you can find this:

If a referendum will pass automatically (e.g., Cryptic Rider, Charming Lobby, Malkavian Rider Clause, Día de los Muertos), then no casting votes or ballots occurs during the automatic referendum, and most "during a political action" and "during a referendum" effects cannot be used. E.g., Delaying Tactics cannot be used to cancel the referendum. Any effects that operate on the number of votes that the referendum passed by have no effect. [LSJ 19980107]

Marko, Prince of Helsinki

Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
Delaying Tactics/Telepathic Vote Counting/Bewitching Oration says "Only usable during a referendum."
Bribes/Madrigal says "Only usable during a referendum before votes and ballots are cast."
Poison Pill adds a comma "Only usable during a referendum, before votes and ballots are cast."

I guess it hinges on whether or not there's a "referendum" step on a vote that will pass automatically. I just want my free pool from playing Bribes or the cycle of playing Madrigal, even if votes won't be tallied.

I'm also curious if you can play Cryptic Rider ("Only usable on a successful referendum.") after the automatically passing vote.

The Alvaro example is weird to me, since you're saying that he gets to "Abstain" even if votes aren't tallied. Which would indicate to me that he'd trigger on a vote canceled by Delaying Tactics if it was played late enough in the referendum.

You can Voter Cap for 0, or chain your Cryptic Riders.
